note: The original Buffalo River outfitter, family-run for 35 years at Bell Bridge on Hwy 13 just north of Waynesboro, with canoe and kayak floats and cabins. Its North and South campgrounds share over a mile of river frontage, but the RV sites sit back from the bank behind trees; a few septic sites are kept for monthly stays. The North Campground is the quieter family area (quiet from 11 p.m.); the South Campground's quiet time starts at midnight, and there is live music with fireworks on the Saturdays of Memorial Day and July 4 weekends. No generators or 4-wheelers. Office and South Campground at 2505 Waynesboro Hwy, North Campground at 2501. --Claude
summary: Crazy Horse: FCFS cash-only river outfitter campground, RV sites 30/50 A + water $40/night (+$10 per extra person 13+), $240/week; open daily Apr-Sep, weekends in Oct, by appointment Nov-Mar (season now manual); facilities + dump confirmed from the operator. Riverview kept (RV placemarks 30-50 m back behind a tree belt, 3-6 m above the river). NOT an OHV park ('Do you allow 4-wheelers? No.'). Google 4.7/935; price gate passes.
